page0.text:
"I'm home!"
"Where have you been, Shirou!?"
"Where have you been, Senpai!?"
"W-whoa!"
I scramble back in a hurry, running backwards into the door.

page1.text: "Don't you 'whoa' us! I told you not to go out by yourself! And while you're still in ill health! Have you taken leave of your senses!?"

page2.text:
"Saber is right!
Your note said that you'd be back by two. Do you know what time it is!? What have you been up to for the last two hours!?"

page3.text:
"Uh...hold on. I know. I get why you're mad. Just calm down..."
If they can just take a deep breath, I should be able to explain myself.

page4.text:
"No, you fail to understand! I honored your wish to go to school alone yesterday, but I will not abide such folly a second time. Why, I'm glad to see you feel so fit and sprightly. That means you must be ready to have me train you until dinner time!"
Saber brushes Sakura aside and advances on me.

page5.text:
"I already cleaned the dojo, so feel free to use it. I've heard how skilled you are, Saber. I'm sure Senpai will be happy to have you coach him!"
Sakura brushes Saber aside and lets me have it.

page6.text:
"Agh... Oof."
...I can see now that one wrong word will add oil to fire, will cast pearls before swine, and result in nothing less than Saber calling our contract null and void.
"Your answer, Shirou!?"
"Your answer, Senpai!?"
"Urgh. I...was wrong."
Clatter, clatter, clatter.
The door to my house spitefully refuses to let me retreat.

page7.text:
"Then let us begin right away. Please bring the first aid kit, Sakura."
"Okay. Do give him a good raking over the coals for us."
The two of them go off into the hallway in perfect sync.

page8.text:
"...Damn. Am I gonna be able to eat dinner tonight?"
Nevertheless, I don't know what worse punishment will await me if I don't go along right now.
All I can do now is drag myself to the dojo as ordered for a thorough education...
